en: Removed the `--sandbox` and `--no-sandbox` flags from `claude remote-control`, which had no effect; passing either now exits with an error. Set `sandbox.enabled` in settings to sandbox sessions
zh: 从 `claude remote-control` 中移除 `--sandbox` 和 `--no-sandbox` 标志，这两个标志此前没有效果；现在传入其中任一标志都会报错退出。如需对 session 启用沙箱，请在设置中设置 `sandbox.enabled`
